prompt: A stylish woman walks down a bustling Tokyo street filled with warm glowing neon and animated city signage. She wears a black leather jacket over a long red dress and black boots, carrying a black purse. She sports sunglasses and red lipstick, walking confidently and casually. The street is damp and reflective, creating a mirror effect of the colorful lights. Many pedestrians walk about, adding to the vibrant atmosphere. Medium shot, dynamic walking perspective.

Several giant wooly mammoths approach, treading through a snowy meadow as their long, wooly fur lightly blows in the wind. Snow-covered trees and dramatic snow-capped mountains loom in the distance. Mid-afternoon light with wispy clouds and a high sun creates a warm glow. A low camera view captures the large, furry mammals with stunning, detailed photography and depth of field.

A movie trailer featuring the adventures of a 30-year-old space man wearing a red wool knitted motorcycle helmet. He explores a vast salt desert under a blue sky, with vivid colors and cinematic style. Shot on 35mm film, the trailer captures him running across the desert, his helmet glinting in the sunlight. Dynamic camera movements and sweeping shots highlight his journey.

Drone view of waves crashing against rugged cliffs along Big Sur’s Garay Point beach. Blue waters create white-tipped waves as golden sunset light illuminates the rocky shore. A small island with a lighthouse sits in the distance, and green shrubbery covers the cliff’s edge. The steep drop from the road down to the beach is a dramatic feat, with cliff edges jutting dramatically over the sea. This captures the raw beauty and rugged landscape of the Pacific Coast Highway.

Animated 3D scene featuring a close-up of a short, fluffy monster kneeling beside a melting red candle. The monster has wide eyes and an open mouth, gazing at the flame with a sense of wonder and curiosity. Its innocent and playful expression conveys exploration and discovery. Warm colors and dramatic lighting enhance the cozy atmosphere. Medium shot, slightly overhead view.

A beautifully detailed papercraft world of a vibrant coral reef, teeming with colorful fish and sea creatures swimming gracefully around the intricate structures. Soft lighting highlights the vivid hues and textures. Close-up view, medium shot.

Close-up shot of a Victoria crowned pigeon showcasing its striking blue plumage and red chest. The bird’s delicate, lacy crest and striking red eye are visible. Its head is tilted slightly, giving a regal and majestic impression. Blurred background draws focus to the bird. Natural flying motion, medium shot.

Photorealistic closeup video of two pirate ships battling each other as they sail inside a steaming cup of coffee. The ships have detailed wooden planks, flying pirate flags, and cannons firing tiny sparks. Sailors with pirate hats and hooks fight on deck, while the background shows steam rising and coffee waves gently moving. Medium shot, dynamic camera movement capturing the intense battle.
